layout_and_spacing.general: Dense but high-contrast spacing. Use sharp corners `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`. Avoid large rounded elements.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 or w-72 flex-col fixed inset-y-0 left-0 border-r-2 border-zinc-800 bg-black z-20
layout_and_spacing.message_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full p-4 md:p-8 space-y-8 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-32
layout_and_spacing.input_area: fixed bottom-0 md:left-64 right-0 max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full p-4 bg-zinc-950/90 backdrop-blur

components.chat_bubble_ai: Border-left 4px solid Rose-500 (`border-l-4 border-rose-500 pl-4`), no background, monospace text, extremely high contrast.
components.chat_bubble_user: Solid dark gray background (`bg-zinc-800/80`), slightly rounded (`rounded-sm`), right-aligned block, `px-4 py-3 max-w-[80%]`.
components.chat_input: Neo-brutalist style. `border-2 border-zinc-700 focus:border-rose-500 bg-black text-white p-4 font-mono`. No rounded corners. Send button should be a sharp square with an edgy icon.
components.new_chat_button: Brutalist button: `border-2 border-rose-500 text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-black uppercase font-bold tracking-widest`.
components.auth_card: Sharp corners, deep black background `bg-black`, neon pink accents, thick border `border-2 border-zinc-800`.
components.badge_savage_mode: `bg-rose-500 text-black font-black uppercase text-xs px-2 py-1 tracking-widest` saying 'SAVAGE MODE: ON [LOCKED]' - prominently displayed in sidebar or header.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Harsh, immediate transitions (`transition-none` or very fast `duration-75`). Hover states should violently flip colors (e.g., `text-rose-500` to `bg-rose-500 text-black`).
motion_and_interactions.typing_effect: Simulate a terminal typing effect or glitch for the AI responses.

icons.style: duotone or bold, giving a mechanical/raw tech vibe.

login_background.description: Dark brutalist abstract background with neon pink and cyber yellow glitch effects.
login_background.usage: Use as the background cover image (w-1/2 or full bg) for the Login/Signup authentication page to establish the aggressive tone.

ai_avatar.description: Aggressive robotic skull avatar logo in neon pink and cyan wireframe.
ai_avatar.usage: Use as the AI's profile picture next to its responses and in the app header/sidebar.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast. Text on dark backgrounds must meet APCA standards.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings or borders.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any typing or glitch animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Use Google Fonts: `Unbounded` for Headings and `JetBrains Mono` for Body.
3. Enforce Tailwind's `zinc` palette (`bg-zinc-950`, `bg-zinc-900`, `border-zinc-800`). Avoid using slate or gray.
4. Strip standard Shadcn softness: force `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` on Buttons, Inputs, Cards, and Dialogs.

5. For Chat Interface: Create a ChatGPT-like layout with a fixed sidebar (left) and main chat area. Chat messages should be clearly distinguishable (User = solid gray block right-aligned; AI = left-aligned, border-left pink, monospace font).
6. Ensure the text 'SAVAGE MODE: ON [LOCKED]' is clearly visible in the UI, enforcing the user requirement.
7. Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, inputs, and major containers.
